note: The leaf is p. 287 'POLITICVS' beginning 'κεχρῆσθαι· πρὸς δὲ ταῦτα' / 'culpet nostram orationem', which Y follows; X gives another leaf (p. 294 'PLATONIS', 'rogatione. eram enim percontaturus').
The leaf is blank with only mirror-image show-through (e.g. 'TERTIO TOMO … SEXTA SYZYGIA'), as X says; Y invents a printed page ('PRIMVS TOMVS', 'EVTHYPHRO … PHAEDO').
The leaf is p. 185 'LACHES' beginning 'βουλευόμεθα, ἢ οὔ' / 'arte valeat', which X follows; Y gives another leaf (p. 192, 'quemadmodum si quærerem quidnam sit celeritas').

Y matches the print in 'οἰνομάοιο πανείκελος', 'θαλπομένῳ', 'ἥμιον ἵππων', 'ἐκούφισε', 'πέλε'; X has wrong words such as 'ὀνομαίοιο ποδύσκελος', 'ἥμισυ', 'ἐπέφισε' (though X gets 'βελαρῇ' where Y has 'βαρείῃ').

Both texts begin roughly as the hand does ('ὡς ἔφαμεν τῶν ἀρχῶν ποιουμένους…', 'ὅτι … σφαῖρα … οὐρανός'), but both soon turn into loose reconstructions that do not follow the faded minuscule line by line, and neither is clearly more faithful.

The hand begins 'ὅτι ἡ ἐπιφάνεια … τοῦ ὕδατος ἠρεμοῦντος' and has the folio number '3', which is close to X; Y supplies a different text altogether (Gregory of Nyssa, 'ὅτι τῶν ἐμφανῶν τὸ θαυμάζεσθαι…').
The leaf is the Greek p. 156 'ΑΦΟΡΙΣΜΟΙ' ('πιτυρώδεα συνεξουρεῖται … LXXXIII'), which Y follows; X gives the English facing page (p. 159, 'FIFTH SECTION … Convulsion after hellebore').
The leaf is p. 667 'DE LEGIBVS LIB. II.' beginning 'διοικεῖν, ὃν δὴ κατ' ἀρχὰς' / 'publ. aptus euadat', which Y follows; X gives another leaf (p. 678, 'priscorum illorum temporum homines').
The leaf is p. 160 'PLATONIS' (Theaetetus, 'imò planè alterũ' / 'καὶ ἄλλο ποιῇ τὸν αἰσθανόμενον'), which Y follows; X gives the opening of the Euthydemus (p. 271).

Y matches the print in 'πρηνὴς', 'μεμυκότι', 'ἀπόσυτον', 'εὐθώρηκες', 'πίσυνος', 'Ζηνὸς', 'ἔνθεος'; X has wrong words such as 'πλευρῆς', 'πίτυος', 'ζωὸς' (though X gets 'ἀντὶ σιδήρου' and the signature 'α 2' right).
